rows.name: Apache Solar 2 (Road Runner) Solar and Battery Energy Storage Facility
rows.quote: Apache Solar 2 (Road Runner) Solar and Battery Energy Storage Facility This project is a photovoltaic (PV) facility with a 235 MW capacity, paired with a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) of 235 MW capacity. This configuration is expected to deliver a maximum output of 261 MW

rows.name: Cochise Substation
rows.quote: which is interconnected to AEPCO’s new 230 kV Cochise Substation, radially fed in close proximity to the Apache 230 kV Substation. The project has been in service as of December 2025.
